parameters.name: Algorithm
parameters.description: The version ID of the CMK. The ID must be globally unique.

parameters.name: KeyId
parameters.description: The operation that you want to perform. Set the value to **AsymmetricSign**.

parameters.name: KeyVersionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the customer master key (CMK). The ID must be globally unique.

>  You can also set this parameter to an alias that is bound to the CMK. For more information, see [Alias overview](~~68522~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms asymmetric-sign --key-id 5c438b18-05be-40ad-b6c2-3be6752c0000 --key-version-id 2ab1a983-7072-4bbc-a582-584b5bd80000 --algorithm RSA_PSS_SHA_256 --digest ZOyIygCyaOW6GjVnihtTFtIS9PNmskdyMlNKiu0000= --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun kms AsymmetricSign --region cn-hangzhou --Digest 'ZOyIygCyaOW6GjVnihtTFtIS9PNmskdyMlNKiu0000=' --DryRun false --KeyId '5c438b18-05be-40ad-b6c2-3be6752c0000' --KeyVersionId '2ab1a983-7072-4bbc-a582-584b5bd80000' --Algorithm RSA_PSS_SHA_256
